title: Astrid and the Veil
author: Emrys Oyelaran
blurb: Isandro Whitlock, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
